steps.label: Monitoring catches the gap

caption: Detected from live input features alone — no need to wait for ground-truth labels.

code:
# Model drift needs ground-truth labels, which
# often arrive on a delay (e.g. a confirmed fraud case):

current_accuracy = score_against_labels(
    predictions, ground_truth_labels
)
if current_accuracy < deployment_time_accuracy - threshold:
    alert("model drift detected: performance has dropped")
caption: A measurable drop in real predictive performance versus training/deployment time.
